findings.title: The rocky valley can be a made route
findings.claim: The verse can also depict forceful route-making or passage through rocky valley terrain.
findings.mechanism: The traversal carrier in جَابُوا۟ meets hard rock as the resistant route and the valley as a directional terrain opening, allowing movement through the landscape while carving remains present.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive not only a fixed carved result but the effort of making a way through resistance.
findings.containment: This is attributed legacy_unbound evidence with medium confidence; the direct rock object keeps actual resistance live and the route reading does not erase fixed rock-cut construction.

epistemic.reason: The HFT trace is exact but legacy_unbound and medium-confidence, so the traversal relation is retained with its coexistence boundary.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir yeri veya ülkeyi yol alıp bir ucundan öteki ucuna geçerek aşma.
branch_activations.carrier: جَابُوا۟ bir alanı baştan başa geçme veya içinden yol alma basıncı taşıyabilir.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: ٱلصَّخْرَ ve ٱلْوَادِın birlikte verdiği sert ve kanallı arazi.
branch_activations.activation: Alan aşma imgesi rock resistance and valley direction ile temas edince, verb can depict a route being forced through the terrain.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Thamud'un eylemi, kayalık vadi içinde yol açan veya yolu baştan başa geçen bir hareket olarak da görünür.
branch_activations.boundary: Yol alma, doğrudan fiziksel kaya temasını koruyan bounded bir yankıdır; serbest yolculuk anlamı kurulmaz.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Dalın temel konusu büyük hacimli ve sert doğal taştır.
branch_activations.carrier: ٱلصَّخْرَ yolun içinden geçilen iri ve sert kaya kütlesini taşır.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: جَابُوا۟ın alanı aşma ve içinden geçme baskısı.
branch_activations.activation: Sert kütle traversal carrier ile buluşunca, route is specified as penetration through resistant material rather than easy open travel.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Yol, kaya kütlesini hesaba katmak zorunda olan bir geçiş olarak belirir.
branch_activations.boundary: Kaya resistance is retained; no independent vessel, plant, or sound branch is activated.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: yükseltiler arasında sel sularına yol veren vadi
branch_activations.facet_statement: Dağ, tepe veya yükseltiler arasında fiziksel bir arazi açıklığı bulunur.
branch_activations.carrier: ٱلْوَادِ hareketi yönlendiren yükseltiler arasındaki arazi açıklığını taşır.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: جَابُوا۟ın alan aşan hareketi ve ٱلصَّخْرَın sert direnç taşıması.
branch_activations.activation: A channelled valley gives directional form to traversal, while rock gives the route its resistance.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Kayalık vadi, içinden geçilerek aşılması gereken doğal bir koridor olarak okunur.
branch_activations.boundary: The valley is a route-setting place; its flood function is not independently asserted in this traversal activation.

findings.title: Rock-cutting can become valley waterwork
findings.claim: The rock-cutting may also be perceived as functional valley engineering that captures or conducts floodwater.
findings.mechanism: The cutting carrier meets the collected-water and excavated-basin branches at جَابُوا۟, while the valley's flood-channel role supplies moving water that a cut space could receive or redirect.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see the intervention as serving a landscape function, not only as monumental stonework.
findings.containment: This is exploratory attributed evidence; it does not assert that a reservoir, catchment, or water system is historically proven, and it preserves the ordinary rock-cutting reading.

epistemic.reason: The exact HFT trace supports the multi-word contact, but its source is legacy_unbound and the resulting waterworks reading is explicitly exploratory.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: birikmiş su veya büyük su teknesi
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir su teknesinde ya da başka bir yerde toplanmış su.
branch_activations.carrier: جَابُوا۟ın açma eylemi, toplanmış suyu karşılayacak bir alan imgesine temas edebilir.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: ٱلْوَادِın sel sularına yol veren vadi olarak taşıdığı akış zemini.
branch_activations.activation: Açma eylemi vadinin su taşıyan kanalıyla buluşunca, çıkarılan alan suyu alabilen veya yönlendirebilen bir boşluk olarak görünür.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Rock-cutting can be seen as making space for collected or redirected water.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch supplies a receiving-water image only; a functioning reservoir or historical purpose is not proven.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: kuyu çukuru veya çevresindeki kazı toprağı
branch_activations.facet_statement: Kuyunun kazılmasıyla oluşan çukur ya da kazılmış yer.
branch_activations.carrier: جَابُوا۟ın delme ve kazma eylemi, kazıyla oluşan çukur alanı taşıyabilir.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: ٱلصَّخْرَın sert kazı malzemesi ve ٱلْوَادِın akış kanalı.
branch_activations.activation: Kazıyla oluşan çukur imgesi kaya ve vadinin birlikte verdiği malzeme-akış ilişkisine temas edince, kesme eylemi bir toplama alanı açabilir.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Kayada açılan çukur, valley water's receiving or routing space as possible appears.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch does not import a literal well or claim that the valley phrase names a well.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir nesneyi, içinde geçişli bir açıklık oluşacak biçimde yarma, delme veya kesme işlemi.
branch_activations.carrier: جَابُوا۟ delip geçerek kesme eylemini taşır.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: ٱلْوَادِın sel akışını taşıyan kanal olarak verdiği işlev.
branch_activations.activation: Geçişli kesme, vadinin akış işleviyle temas edince, fiziksel subtractive act can make a channel, basin, or opening that receives flow.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Thamud'un cutting act may have a functional water-routing dimension in the valley.
branch_activations.boundary: This remains an exploratory functional resonance; ordinary physical cutting is not displaced.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: yükseltiler arasında sel sularına yol veren vadi
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bu açıklık sel suyunun geçtiği bir yol veya dışarıya açılan bir geçit işlevi görür.
branch_activations.carrier: ٱلْوَادِ sel suyunun geçtiği yol veya dışarıya açılan geçidi taşır.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: جَابُوا۟ın kaya içinde açma ve kazma eylemi ile ٱلصَّخْرَın sert malzemesi.
branch_activations.activation: The valley's flood passage meets the carved receiving space, so water movement becomes a separate trigger for reading the intervention as routing or capture.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The worked rock may be imagined as receiving or redirecting floodwater within the valley.
branch_activations.boundary: No complete irrigation system or intentional historical function is asserted beyond this exploratory contact.

findings.title: Opening the rock can disclose an interior
findings.claim: The rock-cutting can be perceived as clearing resistant stone and disclosing an interior that solidity had hidden.
findings.mechanism: The opened-gap carrier and qualified disclosure branch meet the hard-rock carrier, so subtractive removal becomes an act that exposes what the closed mass concealed.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see the material act as a movement from opacity to a newly exposed inside.
findings.containment: This is exploratory attributed evidence; it does not turn the local verb into a general revelation metaphor or specify what the interior contains.

epistemic.reason: The exact HFT trace supplies the carriers and contact, but the source is legacy_unbound and the disclosure result is explicitly exploratory.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: açılmış ya da ortası boş geniş aralık
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir yüzeyde veya iki bölüm arasında açılmış ve genişlemiş boşluk, aralık ya da çukur alan.
branch_activations.carrier: جَابُوا۟ açılmış veya ortası boşaltılmış geniş aralık sonucunu taşıyabilir.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: ٱلصَّخْرَın kapalı ve sert kaya kütlesi olması.
branch_activations.activation: The opened-gap carrier contacts the closed rock mass, so removal is experienced as exposing an inside rather than merely reshaping an exterior.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Rock-cutting leaves a newly opened interior visible within the resistant mass.
branch_activations.boundary: The opening is retained as a bounded spatial result; no specific interior use or structure is supplied.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Örtülü olanı açığa çıkarma değeri, aynı kısa anlatımda ayrı bir bileşen olarak yer alır.
branch_activations.carrier: جَابُوا۟ın açma hareketi örtülü olanı açığa çıkarma basıncına temas edebilir.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: ٱلصَّخْرَın saklayan ve kapatan sert kütle olarak taşıdığı kapalılık.
branch_activations.activation: Disclosure pressure meets the opaque rock carrier, so subtractive cutting can be felt as the release of what was covered.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Kayanın içi, kesme eylemiyle örtülülükten açığa çıkarılmış olarak görülebilir.
branch_activations.boundary: The qualified disclosure facet colors the physical act; it does not establish a separate abstract revelation sense.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Dalın temel konusu büyük hacimli ve sert doğal taştır.
branch_activations.carrier: ٱلصَّخْرَ büyük ve sert doğal taşın kapatıcı kütlesini taşır.
branch_activations.activation: Hard rock supplies the opacity that makes the opened interior a result of subtractive force.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Açığa çıkma, sert kaya kütlesinin kaldırılmasıyla oluşan somut bir iç alan olarak belirir.
branch_activations.boundary: The carrier remains ordinary rock; no hidden content or theological disclosure is asserted.

friction_notes: The four HFT records are exact focus-ayah traces but legacy_unbound; their retained readings are therefore attributed and qualified or exploratory rather than independently lexicalized.
